extensionDescription.message: Cleans cookies and site data from Firefox containers.

popupLoading.description: Status message when the extension is loading the container list.

popupOptions.description: Menu item to open the extension's options screen.

containerDefault.description: Name for the default Firefox container.

containerPrivate.description: Name for the private browsing Firefox container.

cleanConfirm.description: Status message when a further confirmation is requested to clean data.

cleanProgress.description: Status message when a clean operation is in progress.

cleanDone.description: Status message when a clean is complete.

cleanError.description: Status message when a clean operation fails. Instructs the user to check the extension's console for details.

quickList.description: Header text for a user-defined list of containers to clean.

quickListN.description: Header text for a user-defined list of containers to clean, with number.

quickListShortcut.message: Clean containers in the quick clean list
quickListShortcut.description: Keyboard shortcut description for a quick clean list.

quickListShortcutN.description: Keyboard shortcut description for a quick clean list, with number.

quickListDescription.message: The extension's keyboard shortcut will clean these containers.
quickListDescription.description: Long description text for a quick clean list.

quickListRegex.description: Description text for regular expression input. Includes a warning that this feature is for advanced users.

importFromFile.description: Button text to import extension settings from a JSON file.

exportToFile.description: Button text to export extension settings to a downloadable JSON file.

importErrorNotJson.message: That file doesn't look like JSON.
importErrorNotJson.description: Error message when the imported options file does not appear to be valid JSON.

exportFilename.description: Default filename for the JSON settings export.
